svg.data-weight-note: 30.00 lb (13.60 kg) in Table 31; the installation safety text says 20.78 to 21.16 lb (9.43 to 9.6 kg) with supplies and fans
svg.data-sfp28-speeds: 10 GbE by default; 25 GbE in groups of four ports (12 groups)
svg.data-qsfp28-speeds: 100 or 40 GbE, auto-detected from the optic; channelizes to 4 x 10 GbE at 40 GbE
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz, 7.8 A at 100 to 120 VAC or 3.8 A at 200 to 240 VAC
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, 21 A (25 A to 11 A across -36 to -72 VDC)
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, load-sharing; AC and DC of one airflow may be mixed in the 48Y
svg.data-fans: six fan modules; the switch runs 30 seconds without thermal shutdown while one is replaced
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 45 C for airflow-out models, 0 to 40 C for airflow-in models
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C in the shipping container
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 93 percent noncondensing for airflow out, 10 to 93 percent for airflow in
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 3962 m (13000 ft)
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25 GbE SFP28 and 10 GbE SFP+ transceivers and DAC cables; 25 GbE AOC on the QSFP28 side
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100 GbE QSFP28, 40 GbE QSFP+, AOC and DACBO (40 GbE to 4 x 10 GbE)
svg.data-seismic: Designed to comply with Zone 4 earthquake requirements per NEBS GR-63-CORE, Issue 3 (Table 30 wording)
